tools.name: session_create
tools.description: Create a persistent Lua interpreter. Request cancellation aborts allocation and destroys its state.

tools.name: session_execute
tools.description: Execute a complete Lua chunk; explicit return is required. Omitted/null session_id creates an interpreter. Globals persist; locals do not. No automatic output capture. Accepted execution discards unread prior results. Terminal replies consume results. wait_timeout_ms defaults to 600000; null waits indefinitely, zero returns pending. Wait expiry leaves execution running. execution_timeout_ms is a separate hard deadline that kills the session. Request cancellation also kills the session and destroys state. Execution is not read-only or idempotent.

tools.name: session_wait
tools.description: Retrieve the current execution without rerunning it. Zero polls; null waits indefinitely; default 600000 ms. Terminal retrieval consumes the result; pending replies do not. Request cancellation kills the session and destroys state, unlike a wait deadline.

tools.name: session_list
tools.description: List existing sessions, not history. An unknown session after asynchronous work does not imply code never ran or that retrying side effects is safe.

tools.name: session_kill
tools.description: Destroy session state with synchronous best-effort disposal; retain no history. Unconfirmed OS exit is reported without failing the kill operation.
